description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of shares to various news sources as reported in the paper “Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse.” The chart contains 16 slices representing different news outlets and categories. The slices are labeled as follows: Breitbart (grey, 14%), Shareblue (dark grey, 13%), The Daily Caller (green, 8%), Drudge Report (teal, 8%), NPR (purple, 7%), Vox (red, 6%), The Guardian (pink, 5%), BBC (orange, 5%), RT (blue, 3%), Daily Kos (dark blue, 3%), National Review (yellow, 3%), Daily Mail/State (light brown, 3%), Fox News (brown, 3%), CNN (light orange, 3%), PoliticusUSA (red-brown, 3%), and Other (light grey, 3%). Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion, though this is not strictly maintained throughout. A legend is not present on the chart.
